style: Epic surreal sports art poster. The moment is lifted out of the arena and set in a world of its own: a cliff, a storm, the sea, the night sky, a city, a desert, a stage. What stays true are the anchors that make it recognisable - the jersey colours and numbers, the defining pose, the key object and the one fact of the moment. Everything else is invented and dramatic. Every figure named in the scene is there, in the position described, and nobody else. Painterly, bold shapes, dramatic rim light, one dominant colour, vast negative space. Faces in shadow or simplified, never a photographic likeness. No text of any kind except the jersey numbers, no logos, no wordmarks, no border, no caption, no title, no credits, no watermark.

moments.title: The Bounce
moments.prompt: Two figures on the stone edge of a sea cliff at night. A forward in a black jersey with a white 2 is crouched low on his heels, both hands on his knees, staring up. Beside him a tall defender in a white jersey with a red 21 is still in the air, one arm up. Far out over the black water a basketball hoop stands on top of a lighthouse, and the ball is balanced on the front of its rim, glowing like a small moon, caught in the instant before it drops. The lighthouse lamp reads 0.0. The sea below is black with faint red light on the waves. Black, white and red.

moments.title: From the Logo
moments.prompt: One figure, alone, seen from behind. A slight guard in a dark navy jersey with a large gold 30 stands at the very edge of a mountain peak, both arms still raised in the follow-through of a jump shot he has just let go. The ball is a burning comet with a long golden trail arcing across a black night sky over an immense canyon, toward a tiny glowing basketball hoop on the next peak, impossibly far away. Clouds fill the canyon below him. The ground under his feet is a small circle of lit rock. Navy and gold on black.

moments.title: The Dagger
moments.prompt: Two figures on a flat rooftop at the top of a city, the whole sky behind them a solid field of yellow. A guard in a black jersey with a gold 2 is at the top of his jump, releasing a step-back three, the ball just off his fingertips above his head. Directly in front of him a defender in a white jersey with a gold 30 lunges a half step too late, right arm stretched up toward the ball, off balance. The ball's path is a thin red line slicing across the yellow sky toward a hoop on a distant tower at the left edge. Black, wine red and gold on yellow.

moments.title: The Last Shot
moments.prompt: Two figures on a frozen lake at night under a huge pale moon. A guard in a red jersey with a black 23 is frozen in a full follow-through: right arm extended, wrist snapped down, fingers hanging, feet just landing on the ice. One stride to his left a defender in a white jersey with purple trim is slipping backward and away on the ice, off balance, one hand reaching down toward the surface. The ball hangs halfway to a hoop that stands alone on the ice at the top right. The moon's face reads 5.2. Snow and black sky. Red, white and purple on black and ice blue.

moments.title: The Shrug
moments.prompt: One figure, alone, seen from the front. A guard in a white jersey with a red 23 jogs toward the viewer across a dark plain, shoulders raised, both palms turned up and out, head tilted and turned to his right, the universal shrug. Above him the whole sky is on fire: six basketballs hang in an arc like six burning suns, each trailing flame, lighting the plain beneath. Nothing else in the frame. White and red figure, orange suns, black ground.

moments.title: The Flu Game
moments.prompt: Two figures crossing a narrow stone bridge through a storm, walking toward the viewer. The one on the right, in a red jersey with a white 23, is slumped and spent, head hanging, legs barely under him. The one on the left, in a red jersey with a white 33, holds him up with an arm wrapped around his shoulders. Rain slants across the frame, the bridge drops into fog on both sides, and the only light is a sickly green glow from below. The two red jerseys are the only saturated colour. Red on black with green shadows.

moments.title: The Block
moments.prompt: Two giant figures above the clouds, the sky behind them a solid wall of yellow. A guard in a white jersey with a gold 9 is in the air at the end of a layup, the ball leaving his hand toward a basketball hoop whose backboard is a sheet of glass the size of the sky. A forward in a black jersey with a gold 23 has flown in from the left at full stretch and pins the ball flat against that glass with his right hand, inches from the rim. Cracks spread across the glass from the ball. Seen from below. Black, white and gold on yellow.

moments.title: The Lob
moments.prompt: Three figures across a city at night. On top of the tallest skyscraper a huge centre in a gold jersey with a purple 34 is above a basketball hoop with both hands on the ball, catching an alley-oop, about to dunk, mouth open. Far below on the roof of a lower building, a guard in gold with a purple 8 stands with his right arm still pointed up at the hoop, the pass's path a thin gold arc across the whole night sky between them. At the foot of the tower a defender in black is beaten, arms down, looking up. Deep purple sky, gold windows. Gold and purple.

moments.title: The Skyhook
moments.prompt: Two figures the size of mountains standing in the sea at night. A seven-foot centre in a gold jersey with a purple 33, wearing goggles, is turned sideways and releasing a hook shot: left arm raised across his body as a shield, right arm fully straight above his head, the ball leaving his fingertips at the very top of the frame, where it becomes the moon. A defender in a green jersey with a white 00 stands chest to chest with him, both arms reaching up and still a full head short. Waves break around their knees. Black sky, gold moonlight on the water. Gold, purple and green on black.

moments.title: The Dream Shake
moments.prompt: Two figures on a round stage under a single spotlight, in a dark theatre. A centre in a red jersey with a white 34 is mid-pivot with his back to a hoop at the top of the frame, spinning toward the viewer with the ball tucked at his hip and his head turned over his shoulder to find the rim, like a dancer at the turn. Three ghost images of him trail off to the right, showing the fake he just sold the other way. The defender in a white jersey with a black 50 leans hard the wrong way beside him, feet crossed, one hand grabbing at empty air, dissolving into smoke. Red and white on black.

moments.title: The Shot
moments.prompt: Two figures weightless in deep water, seen from the side, light falling from the surface above. A guard in a red jersey with a white 23 hangs at the top of his rise, knees tucked, the ball at the top of a double-clutch release above his head. The defender in a white jersey with orange and blue trim has already drifted past him to the left, arm up, too early, sinking. Far above them a basketball hoop floats at the surface at the top right, and a clock made of light reads 0:03. Bubbles rise. Red, white and orange in dark blue-black water.

moments.title: From the Line
moments.prompt: One figure, alone, flying through a night sky between two banks of cloud. A guard in a red jersey with a black 23, seen in strict side profile, body stretched flat and horizontal, legs split front and back, the ball held high in his right hand with the arm straight, soaring toward a basketball hoop that stands on a cloud at the right edge of the frame. Far below him, on the dark earth, a single glowing line marks where he took off. Thousands of tiny camera flashes fill the sky like stars. Red and gold on black.

moments.title: The Stepover
moments.prompt: Two figures on the sand of an empty colosseum at night, lit by one torch. A small guard in a white jersey with a black 3, a black sleeve on his right arm and a white headband, steps over a defender who lies flat on his back in the sand in a gold jersey with a purple 10, the guard looking down at him as he passes. Seen from the side at ground level, the standing figure towering out of the top of the frame, long hard shadows across the sand, the stone arches of the colosseum dark behind. White, gold and purple on black.

moments.title: The Dunk of Death
moments.prompt: Two figures in a ruined stone temple at dawn. A guard in a dark navy jersey with a white 9 is at the top of a leap, legs spread wide, clearing the head of a seven-foot defender in a white jersey who stands under him and ducks, the ball slammed down one-handed through a basketball hoop that hangs from the temple's broken arch at the top of the frame. Seen from the side. Pale blue dawn light through the columns, dust in the air. Navy and white on pale blue and stone.
